title: Buffooncraft Season 6 Modpack
description: Buffooncraft Season 6 is a Vanilla+ modpack designed to enhance Minecraft without losing the classic feel. Built for the Buffooncraft SMP
body:
Buffooncraft Season 6 is a Vanilla+ modpack designed to enhance Minecraft without losing the classic feel. Built for the Buffooncraft SMP, this pack focuses on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and subtle gameplay enhancements while keeping the core survival experience intact.

Expect better optimization, smoother multiplayer performance, and useful client/server tweaks that make exploring, building, and adventuring more enjoyable without drastically changing vanilla mechanics.
